turns.text: You got a fast car
turns.zh: 你有一辆快车

turns.text: I want a ticket to anywhere
turns.zh: 我想买张票，去哪都行

turns.text: Maybe we make a deal
turns.zh: 也许咱俩可以做个交易

turns.text: Maybe together we can get somewhere
turns.zh: 也许一起能闯出点名堂

turns.text: Any place is better
turns.zh: 哪个地方都比这儿强

turns.text: Starting from zero, got nothing to lose
turns.zh: 从零开始，反正也没什么可失去的

turns.text: Maybe we'll make something
turns.zh: 也许我们能干出点什么

turns.text: Me, myself, I got nothing to prove
turns.zh: 我嘛，我自己，没什么要证明的

turns.text: You got a fast car
turns.zh: 你有一辆快车

turns.text: I got a plan to get us out of here
turns.zh: 我有个计划，带咱俩离开这儿

turns.text: I been working at the convenience store
turns.zh: 我一直在便利店打工

turns.text: Managed to save just a little bit of money
turns.zh: 好不容易攒了一点点钱

turns.text: Won't have to drive too far
turns.zh: 不用开太远

turns.text: Just 'cross the border and into the city
turns.zh: 过了边境就到城里

turns.text: You and I can both get jobs
turns.zh: 你和我都能找到工作

turns.text: And finally see what it means to be living
turns.zh: 终于能看看活着到底是什么意思

turns.text: See, my old man's got a problem
turns.zh: 你看，我爸有个毛病

turns.text: He lives with the bottle, that's the way it is
turns.zh: 他整天抱着酒瓶子，就是这么回事

turns.text: He says his body's too old for working
turns.zh: 他说他身子太老了，干不动活了

turns.text: His body's too young to look like his
turns.zh: 可他的身子又太年轻，不该看起来那么老

turns.text: My mama went off and left him
turns.zh: 我妈走了，丢下了他

turns.text: She wanted more from life than he could give
turns.zh: 她想要的生活，他给不了

turns.text: I said, somebody's got to take care of him
turns.zh: 我说，总得有人照顾他

turns.text: So I quit school and that's what I did
turns.zh: 所以我退了学，就这么做了

turns.text: You got a fast car
turns.zh: 你有一辆快车

turns.text: Is it fast enough so we can fly away?
turns.zh: 它够快吗，能让我们飞走吗？

turns.text: We gotta make a decision
turns.zh: 我们得做个决定

turns.text: Leave tonight or live and die this way
turns.zh: 今晚就走，还是就这样活到死

turns.text: So I remember we were driving, driving in your car
turns.zh: 所以我记得我们开着车，开着你的车

turns.text: Speed so fast, I felt like I was drunk
turns.zh: 速度那么快，我感觉像喝醉了一样

turns.text: City lights lay out before us
turns.zh: 城市的灯光铺展在我们面前

turns.text: And your arm felt nice wrapped 'round my shoulder
turns.zh: 你的手臂搂着我的肩膀，感觉真好

turns.text: And I-I, had a feeling that I belonged
turns.zh: 而我，我有一种归属感

turns.text: I-I had a feeling I could be someone, be someone, be someone
turns.zh: 我，我有一种感觉，我可以成为某个人，成为某个人，成为某个人

turns.text: You got a fast car
turns.zh: 你有一辆快车

turns.text: We go cruising to entertain ourselves
turns.zh: 我们开车兜风来打发时间

turns.text: You still ain't got a job
turns.zh: 你还是没找到工作

turns.text: And I work in a market as a checkout girl
turns.zh: 我在市场里当收银员

turns.text: I know things will get better
turns.zh: 我知道事情会好起来的

turns.text: You'll find work and I'll get promoted
turns.zh: 你会找到工作，我会升职

turns.text: We'll move out of the shelter
turns.zh: 我们会搬出收容所

turns.text: Buy a bigger house and live in the suburbs
turns.zh: 买个大点的房子，住在郊区

turns.text: You stay out drinking late at the bar
turns.zh: 你却在酒吧喝到很晚

turns.text: See more of your friends than you do of your kids
turns.zh: 见朋友比见孩子还多

turns.text: I'd always hoped for better
turns.zh: 我一直希望着能更好

turns.text: Thought maybe together you and me would find it
turns.zh: 以为也许你和我一起能找到

turns.text: I got no plans, I ain't going nowhere
turns.zh: 我没什么计划了，我哪儿也不去

turns.text: So take your fast car and keep on driving
turns.zh: 所以带着你的快车，继续开吧
